content.short: Earn sustainable, passive yields on multiple chains with Akropolis.
content.description: Founded in 2017, Akropolis aims to create an autonomous financial ecosystem for saving and growing wealth through its decentralized finance protocol. The project includes AkropolisOS, a framework for developing for-profit DAOs; Sparta, a platform for uncollateralized lending; and Delphi, a yield farming aggregator with dollar-cost averaging capabilities. Governance across its suite of products is managed through an ERC-20 token named AKRO, used to coordinate decisions and drive protocol upgrades within the ecosystem.
content.meta: Akropolis provides a financial ecosystem for saving and growing wealth with its DeFi protocol. Discover Akropolis and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
